footnotes: 4.75 mg of selected antibiotics was mixed with 0.25 mg of peptide.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Mechanism of Action and Synergistic Effects of RWn Peptides with Antibiotics
header_rows: Anchors peptide to membrane through hydrophobic & π–π interactions
Facilitates antibiotic entry by disrupting membrane
Strong interaction with fungal membranes, lower with mammalian
Provides positive charge, targets anionic membrane phospholipids
Essential for selective targeting of fungal cells
Causes ion leakage, loss of membrane potential, cell lysis
Enhances antibiotic action by increasing cell access
Higher in fungal cells due to membrane composition differences
Disrupts α-helix formation, increases membrane selectivity
Reduces hemolysis and cytotoxicity while maintaining antifungal activity
Combines membrane disruption with intracellular inhibition
Antibiotics like VAN, PEN, and AMP are more effective
Synergy enables lower antibiotic dosages, reducing side effects
